notes: Ordinary one-shot HIE is computed once on the full train split for each z-window. It uses the same feature engineering, chronological split, precomputed future_log_ret, counterfactual payoff semantics, entry/exit union ranking, and HIE parameters as the BS-Stable-HIE pipeline, but WITHOUT block subsampling and WITHOUT selection-frequency filtering. Artifacts are saved into a separate timestamped folder to avoid overwriting existing data.
